description: Shared cross-SDK 'must-reject' binary decoding vectors (AVRO-4304). Each vector is a schema plus a raw binary payload (hex) that a conformant Avro binary decoder MUST reject with a bounded, well-defined error (an Avro/IO error) rather than accepting it, crashing (StackOverflowError), or exhausting memory (OutOfMemoryError). Payloads are hex-encoded bytes. The 'schema' field is the Avro schema as a JSON string. The 'category' groups the kind of malformation. These vectors lock in, across every language SDK, the decoder-hardening behaviour introduced under AVRO-4292 and siblings.

vectors.name: long_varint_non_terminating
vectors.comment: A long varint whose continuation bit is still set after 10 bytes (64 bits) never terminates and must be rejected.

vectors.name: int_varint_non_terminating
vectors.comment: An int varint whose continuation bit is still set after 5 bytes (32 bits) never terminates and must be rejected.

vectors.name: array_block_count_int64_min
vectors.comment: Array block count encoded as Long.MIN_VALUE. Its absolute value cannot be represented (negation overflows), so it must be rejected rather than driving an unbounded read.

vectors.name: bytes_length_negative
vectors.comment: A bytes value with a negative length prefix (-1) must be rejected.

vectors.name: string_length_negative
vectors.comment: A string value with a negative length prefix (-1) must be rejected.

vectors.name: union_branch_index_negative
vectors.comment: A union branch index of -1 is outside the range of declared branches and must be rejected.

vectors.name: union_branch_index_too_large
vectors.comment: A union branch index of 5 exceeds the 2 declared branches and must be rejected.

vectors.name: enum_index_negative
vectors.comment: An enum symbol index of -1 is outside the range of declared symbols and must be rejected.

vectors.name: enum_index_too_large
vectors.comment: An enum symbol index of 5 exceeds the 2 declared symbols and must be rejected.
